lines.text: The root is Pend! Depend, suspend, expense.
Did you know? Pend is Latin for hang.
Suspend: up from under plus hang.
Quick quiz! Which means out plus hang?

words.ex: Our plans depend on the weather.
The match was suspended because of the rain.
Travel expenses will be paid by the company.

publish.title: Pend root: depend, suspend and expense
publish.value: Pend comes from Latin "pendere" (to hang, to weigh). Words: depend, suspend and expense. depend = de + pend; suspend = sus + pend; expense = ex + pense.
